title: Making friends
examples: What should I say if I want to play with a group?
How can I use kind words when someone is sad?
What if they say no when I ask to play?

explain.say: Sometimes you see other children playing. You might want to join their fun.

draw.text: Joining a game: What to say

explain.say: You can try saying, 'Can I play too?' This is a good way to ask.
If they say yes, you can ask, 'What are the rules?' This helps you play right.

items: If yes, ask 'What are the rules?'

explain.say: When you use kind words, it makes friends feel happy. Say, 'Good job!' to them.
If someone falls down, you can say, 'Are you okay?' This shows you care a lot.
When you are at the playground, you see kids building a tower. You can ask, 'Can I help build this?' This shows you want to join their fun. They might say yes, and you can ask what pieces they need.
A common mistake is waiting until you are already playing to say hello. Remember to try asking to join the fun first. A simple question can start a great game with new friends.

faq.q: What if I ask to play and they say no?
faq.a: It is okay if they say no right away. You can say, 'Okay, maybe later.' Then you can play near them.
asks: What do I do if they say no?
Should I keep asking if they say no?

faq.q: What are some other things I can say to join a game?
faq.a: You can try saying, 'Wow, that looks fun!' This shows you are interested in what they are doing.
asks: How can I join without saying 'Can I play'?
What is another way to ask to join?

faq.a: Kind words are words that make someone feel happy and safe. They are words that help others feel good inside.
asks: How do I know if my words are kind?

faq.q: Do I have to be good at games to play?
faq.a: No, you do not have to be the best player. Just wanting to play with them is the most important thing.
asks: Can I play even if I am not good?
Do I need to be good at games?

faq.q: What if I accidentally bump into someone?
faq.a: You should say, 'Oops, sorry!' Saying sorry is using a kind word to fix a small mistake.
asks: What to say if I bump someone?

facts: Asking to join a game is polite.
Saying 'Please' and 'Thank you' are kind words.
It is okay to feel sad when friends do not play with you.
Using kind words helps build friendships.

quiz.say: You see children playing with blocks. You want to join them. What is a good thing to say?
quiz.show: Joining a game: What to say?
quiz.why: This question asks for a direct, polite way to ask to join the fun.

wrong.0: This sounds bossy and might make friends feel upset.
wrong.1: This is too loud and sounds like a demand.
wrong.2: This tries to get attention but is not a good way to ask.

quiz.say: Your friend draws a beautiful picture. What is a kind thing to say?
quiz.why: This answer uses positive words to notice something good the friend did.

wrong.0: While true, it is less specific than noticing a color or detail.
wrong.2: This does not tell the friend anything nice about the picture.
wrong.3: This only talks about size and not how good it looks.

quiz.say: You accidentally knock over a tower your friend built. What should you say?
quiz.why: This uses a clear apology, which is a very kind thing to do.

wrong.1: This blames the tower instead of apologizing for the action.
wrong.2: This tells the friend how to feel instead of fixing the mistake.
wrong.3: Saying it is fine ignores the fact that you made a mess.
